claim: Sample data opens a realistic payment API handoff room.
where: Landing primary action and demo room heading
sandbox: fresh browser context; open /demo; assert seeded payment-status room and selected sanitized fixture

claim: A reviewer can record a named acknowledgement in the sample room.
sandbox: fresh browser context; complete required sample checklist; type reviewer name; assert dated acknowledgement receipt

claim: Exports a handover JSON file with the selected fixture, decisions, checklist, and acknowledgement.
sandbox: fresh browser context; acknowledge sample room; download and parse JSON; assert the four sections and reviewer name

claim: Demo changes stay in a separate browser storage namespace.
sandbox: fresh browser context; mutate and reset demo; assert storage keys use demo: prefix and request log has no cross-origin requests

claim: The demo sends no fixture, checklist, or acknowledgement data and uses no cookies, analytics, third-party fonts, or third-party scripts.
sandbox: fresh browser context; complete acknowledgement; assert every request is a bodyless same-origin GET and cookies, sessionStorage, and IndexedDB remain empty

claim: The prepared sample contains no secret-like values.
sandbox: fresh demo; scan the complete displayed fixture for credential, token, password, private-key, and JWT patterns

claim: The server removes common secret-like values before a real fixture can be saved.
sandbox: in-memory database; nested secret corpus plus safe control value; assert every secret is removed and the control is preserved

claim: A signed-in agency can save and reload a client handoff room with a scoped private review link.
where: Rooms, create-room, room, and review pages
sandbox: in-memory database and test identity; create agency and room, reload it, deny another tenant, and open only with the scoped review token

claim: A signed-in agency member can import a selected GitHub JSON fixture, review redaction, name a decision owner, and create a client room.
sandbox: test-only browser identity and intercepted API; complete the full create-room form and assert the saved room reloads with sanitized content

claim: A client reviewer can ask a question and acknowledge one room revision without an agency account.
sandbox: fresh public review route with scoped fixture; submit a question, complete the checklist, acknowledge, and assert the revision receipt

claim: Product reads stay below 20 requests per second with a burst of 40 for each forwarded client IP.
sandbox: fresh limiter; send 45 requests from one first-hop X-Forwarded-For address; assert 429 and Retry-After

claim: Studio never shows a checkout action until the Sociobot subscription product is registered and verified.
where: Landing pricing, billing, and terms pages
sandbox: fresh billing page without a registered product; assert an unavailable status and no checkout link

claim: Fixture import requires a repository selected through the GitHub connection.
sandbox: test identity with no selected repositories; assert the raw owner/repository fields are absent and connect guidance is visible

claim: Agency owners can permanently delete their workspace and connected records.
sandbox: test identity; type DELETE; assert a DELETE API request and return to rooms
